newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iran cuts August crude oil term price -- traders.
newsitem.headline: Iran cuts August crude oil term price -- traders.

text.p: State-owned National Iranian Oil Co (NIOC) has decided to cut its August crude price formula for Iranian Light by 40 cents per barrel and Iranian Heavy by 10 cents per barrel, traders said on Friday.

Following the decision, Iranian Light for August loading will be priced at Oman's MPM minus 67 cents, with an automatic adjustment factor added to that, down from MPM minus 27 cents for July, traders said.
Iranian Heavy's August term price will be priced at Dubai minus 23 cents, down from MPM minus 13 cents for July, they said.
The term price of Iranian Light crude fluctuates in line with that of Saudi Arabia's Arab Light, while Iranian Heavy reflects the movement of Arab Medium.
Iranian term prices are negotiated on a quarterly basis.
However, there is a clause in term contracts which allows NIOC and its customers to review prices whenever Saudi Arabian crude prices move significantly.
